```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

df_all <- read_tsv("ALL_Combined.bed", col_names = TRUE)

# Create averaged 3D distance column, remove Dist_A / Dist_B,
# and move Group to the last column
MODEL_data_new <- df_all %>%
  mutate(`3D_Distance` = (Dist_A + Dist_B) / 2) %>%
  select(-Dist_A, -Dist_B) %>%
  relocate(Group, .after = last_col())

# Check result
head(MODEL_data_new)

# Save new file
write_tsv(MODEL_data_new, "ALL_Combined_10082026.tsv")
```



```{r}
# ============================================================
# LOAD REQUIRED LIBRARIES
# ============================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(gghalves)
library(ggdist)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)


# ============================================================
# 1. PREPARE DATA
# ============================================================

df_long <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(Group, CPD_Enrichment) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Group),
    !is.na(CPD_Enrichment)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "C_H_M_H",
        "C_H_M_L",
        "C_L_M_H",
        "C_L_M_L"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 2. PAIRWISE COMPARISONS
# ============================================================

comparisons <- list(
  c("C_H_M_H", "C_H_M_L"),
  c("C_H_M_H", "C_L_M_H"),
  c("C_H_M_H", "C_L_M_L"),
  c("C_H_M_L", "C_L_M_H"),
  c("C_H_M_L", "C_L_M_L"),
  c("C_L_M_H", "C_L_M_L")
)


# ============================================================
# 3. KRUSKAL-WALLIS TEST
# ============================================================

kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(
  CPD_Enrichment ~ Group,
  data = df_long
)

kw_stat <- round(
  as.numeric(kruskal_res$statistic),
  3
)

kw_p <- signif(
  kruskal_res$p.value,
  3
)


# ============================================================
# 4. RAINCLOUD PLOT
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot(
  df_long,
  aes(
    x = Group,
    y = CPD_Enrichment,
    fill = Group,
    color = Group
  )
) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Half violin
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    adjust = 0.5,
    justification = -0.2,
    .width = 0,
    point_colour = NA
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Jittered individual clusters
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.1,
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 1
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Boxplot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.2,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 1,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Kruskal-Wallis
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 4.2,
    y = max(
      df_long$CPD_Enrichment,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) * 0.95,
    label = paste(
      "Kruskal-Wallis:",
      "\nChi-squared =",
      kw_stat,
      "\nP =",
      kw_p
    ),
    size = 3,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Pairwise Wilcoxon tests
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = comparisons,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    p.adjust.method = "fdr"
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Labels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  labs(
    title = "CPD Enrichment Across Mutation–CPD Groups",
    x = "Group",
    y = "CPD Enrichment"
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Colors
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "C_H_M_H" = "#F28C9D",
      "C_H_M_L" = "#F3E065",
      "C_L_M_H" = "#65C9F3",
      "C_L_M_L" = "#9EAAE0"
    )
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "C_H_M_H" = "#F28C9D",
      "C_H_M_L" = "#F3E065",
      "C_L_M_H" = "#65C9F3",
      "C_L_M_L" = "#9EAAE0"
    )
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Theme
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),

    legend.position = "none"
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. SHOW PLOT
# ============================================================

print(p)
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)


# ============================================================
# 1. Define XR columns and group order
# ============================================================

xr_cols <- c(
  "XR_12m",
  "XR_1h",
  "XR_4h",
  "XR_8h",
  "XR_16h",
  "XR_24h",
  "XR_48h"
)

group_order <- c(
  "C_H_M_H",
  "C_H_M_L",
  "C_L_M_H",
  "C_L_M_L"
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Convert to long format
# ============================================================

df_long <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(Group, all_of(xr_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(xr_cols),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "XR_value"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Group),
    !is.na(XR_value)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    ),
    Timepoint = factor(
      Timepoint,
      levels = xr_cols
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. Pairwise Wilcoxon function
# ============================================================

make_pairwise_heatmap_df <- function(data_one_tp) {
  
  groups <- group_order
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Group mean
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  group_means <- data_one_tp %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_value = mean(XR_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # All pair combinations
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  pair_df <- expand.grid(
    Group1 = groups,
    Group2 = groups,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Difference and Wilcoxon P-value
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  pair_df <- pair_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      
      mean1 = group_means$mean_value[
        match(Group1, as.character(group_means$Group))
      ],
      
      mean2 = group_means$mean_value[
        match(Group2, as.character(group_means$Group))
      ],
      
      mean_diff = mean1 - mean2,
      
      abs_diff = abs(mean_diff),
      
      p_value = if (Group1 == Group2) {
        
        NA_real_
        
      } else {
        
        x <- data_one_tp %>%
          filter(Group == Group1) %>%
          pull(XR_value)
        
        y <- data_one_tp %>%
          filter(Group == Group2) %>%
          pull(XR_value)
        
        wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # FDR correction
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  non_diag <- !is.na(pair_df$p_value)
  
  pair_df$p_adj <- NA_real_
  
  pair_df$p_adj[non_diag] <- p.adjust(
    pair_df$p_value[non_diag],
    method = "fdr"
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Significance
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  pair_df <- pair_df %>%
    mutate(
      signif_label = case_when(
        is.na(p_adj)  ~ "",
        p_adj < 0.0001 ~ "****",
        p_adj < 0.001  ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01   ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05   ~ "*",
        TRUE           ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  
  return(pair_df)
}


# ============================================================
# 4. Apply to all XR timepoints
# ============================================================

heatmap_df <- df_long %>%
  group_split(Timepoint) %>%
  map_dfr(
    function(tp_df) {
      
      tp_name <- unique(tp_df$Timepoint)
      
      out <- make_pairwise_heatmap_df(tp_df)
      
      out$Timepoint <- tp_name
      
      out
    }
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. Factor order
# ============================================================

heatmap_df <- heatmap_df %>%
  mutate(
    Group1 = factor(
      Group1,
      levels = group_order
    ),
    
    Group2 = factor(
      Group2,
      levels = rev(group_order)
    ),
    
    Timepoint = factor(
      Timepoint,
      levels = xr_cols
    )
  )


print(heatmap_df)

write.csv(
  heatmap_df,
  "XR_feature_pairwise_wilcox_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 6. Plot
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot(
  heatmap_df,
  aes(
    x = Group1,
    y = Group2,
    fill = mean_diff
  )
) +
  
  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    aes(label = signif_label),
    color = "black",
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Timepoint,
    ncol = 3
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#7678ed",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#fe6d73",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Mean difference"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Pairwise XR Differences Between Groups at Each Time Point",
    x = "Group",
    y = "Group"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    )
  )


print(p)

# ggsave(
#   "XR_pairwise_group_heatmap_by_timepoint.pdf",
#   p,
#   width = 12,
#   height = 10
# )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

overall_test_df <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    statistic = as.numeric(
      kruskal.test(XR_value ~ Group)$statistic
    ),
    
    p_value = kruskal.test(
      XR_value ~ Group
    )$p.value,
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    p_adj = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "fdr"
    ),
    
    signif_label = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      p_adj < 0.001  ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01   ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE           ~ "ns"
    )
  )


print(overall_test_df)

write.csv(
  overall_test_df,
  "XR_timepoint_overall_kruskal_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```



```{r}
library(pheatmap)


# ============================================================
# Matrix for heatmap
# ============================================================

overall_mat <- matrix(
  -log10(overall_test_df$p_adj),
  nrow = 1,
  dimnames = list(
    "Overall group diff",
    as.character(overall_test_df$Timepoint)
  )
)


# ============================================================
# Display adjusted P-value and significance
# ============================================================

overall_labels <- matrix(
  
  paste0(
    sprintf(
      "%.2e",
      overall_test_df$p_adj
    ),
    "\n",
    overall_test_df$signif_label
  ),
  
  nrow = 1,
  dimnames = dimnames(overall_mat)
)


# ============================================================
# Plot
# ============================================================

pheatmap(
  overall_mat,
  scale = "none",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = colorRampPalette(
    c(
      "#7678ed",
      "white",
      "#fe6d73"
    )
  )(100),
  display_numbers = overall_labels,
  number_color = "black",
  fontsize_number = 10,
  main = "Overall XR Group Difference at Each Time Point",
  border_color = "grey80"
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)


# ============================================================
# Define group order
# ============================================================

group_order <- c(
  "C_H_M_H",
  "C_H_M_L",
  "C_L_M_H",
  "C_L_M_L"
)


# ============================================================
# Define XR columns
# ============================================================

xr_cols <- c(
  "XR_12m",
  "XR_1h",
  "XR_4h",
  "XR_8h",
  "XR_16h",
  "XR_24h",
  "XR_48h"
)


# ============================================================
# XR sum for each cluster
# ============================================================

MODEL_data_new <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  mutate(
    XR_sum = rowSums(
      select(
        .,
        all_of(xr_cols)
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Mean XR sum for each group
# ============================================================

group_xr_avg <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(
    Group,
    XR_sum
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Group),
    !is.na(XR_sum)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_XR_sum = mean(
      XR_sum,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(group_xr_avg)


# ============================================================
# Mean CPD enrichment
# ============================================================

cpd_group_mean <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(
    Group,
    CPD_Enrichment
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Group),
    !is.na(CPD_Enrichment)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_CPD_Enrichment = mean(
      CPD_Enrichment,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(cpd_group_mean)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


# ============================================================
# 1. GROUP ORDER
# ============================================================

group_order <- c(
  "C_H_M_H",
  "C_H_M_L",
  "C_L_M_H",
  "C_L_M_L"
)


# ============================================================
# 2. XR COLUMNS
# ============================================================

xr_cols <- c(
  "XR_12m",
  "XR_1h",
  "XR_4h",
  "XR_8h",
  "XR_16h",
  "XR_24h",
  "XR_48h"
)


# ============================================================
# 3. XR SUM
# ============================================================

MODEL_data_new <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  mutate(
    XR_sum = rowSums(
      select(
        .,
        all_of(xr_cols)
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 4. GROUP MEAN XR
# ============================================================

group_xr_avg <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(
    Group,
    XR_sum
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Group),
    !is.na(XR_sum)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_XR_sum = mean(
      XR_sum,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. GROUP MEAN CPD
# ============================================================

cpd_group_mean <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(
    Group,
    CPD_Enrichment
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Group),
    !is.na(CPD_Enrichment)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_CPD_Enrichment = mean(
      CPD_Enrichment,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. MERGE
# ============================================================

plot_df <- left_join(
  cpd_group_mean,
  group_xr_avg,
  by = "Group"
) %>%
  arrange(Group)


print(plot_df)


# ============================================================
# 7. DAMAGE MULTIPLIER
# ============================================================

CPD_multiplier <- 4


plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Damage_plot = mean_CPD_Enrichment * CPD_multiplier,
    Repair_plot = mean_XR_sum
  )


print(plot_df)


# ============================================================
# 8. LONG FORMAT
# ============================================================

circular_data_long <- bind_rows(
  
  data.frame(
    Group = plot_df$Group,
    Type = "Damage",
    Value = plot_df$Damage_plot,
    Raw_Value = plot_df$mean_CPD_Enrichment,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  
  data.frame(
    Group = plot_df$Group,
    Type = "Repair",
    Value = plot_df$Repair_plot,
    Raw_Value = plot_df$mean_XR_sum,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 9. DEFINE DAMAGE/REPAIR ORDER
# ============================================================

circular_data_long$Category_Split <- interaction(
  circular_data_long$Group,
  circular_data_long$Type,
  sep = ":"
)


circular_data_long$Category_Split <- factor(
  
  circular_data_long$Category_Split,
  
  levels = c(
    
    "C_H_M_H:Damage",
    "C_H_M_H:Repair",
    
    "C_H_M_L:Damage",
    "C_H_M_L:Repair",
    
    "C_L_M_H:Damage",
    "C_L_M_H:Repair",
    
    "C_L_M_L:Damage",
    "C_L_M_L:Repair"
  )
)


circular_data_long$Group <- factor(
  circular_data_long$Group,
  levels = group_order
)


# ============================================================
# 10. LABEL RAW VALUES
# ============================================================

circular_data_long <- circular_data_long %>%
  mutate(
    label_text = ifelse(
      Type == "Damage",
      paste0(
        "CPD=",
        round(Raw_Value, 2)
      ),
      paste0(
        "XR=",
        round(Raw_Value, 2)
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 11. PLOT
# ============================================================

plot_circle <- ggplot(
  circular_data_long,
  aes(
    x = Category_Split,
    y = Value,
    fill = Group,
    alpha = Type
  )
) +
  
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    position = "stack",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  coord_polar() +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(
      2.5,
      4.5,
      6.5,
      8.5
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  labs(
    fill = "Group",
    alpha = "Type",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = paste0(
      "Group-wise CPD and Repair Levels (CPD × ",
      CPD_multiplier,
      ")"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "C_H_M_H" = "#F28C9D",
      "C_H_M_L" = "#F3E065",
      "C_L_M_H" = "#65C9F3",
      "C_L_M_L" = "#9EAAE0"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c(
      "Damage" = 0.35,
      "Repair" = 1
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_line(
      color = "lightgray",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ),
    
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


print(plot_circle)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# =========================
# Repair average per group — time-course line plot
# =========================

# 1) Define XR columns and time order
xr_cols <- c(
  "XR_12m",
  "XR_1h",
  "XR_4h",
  "XR_8h",
  "XR_16h",
  "XR_24h",
  "XR_48h"
)

time_order <- c(
  "12m",
  "1h",
  "4h",
  "8h",
  "16h",
  "24h",
  "48h"
)

# New CPD-first group naming
group_order <- c(
  "C_H_M_H",
  "C_H_M_L",
  "C_L_M_H",
  "C_L_M_L"
)


# =========================
# 2) Calculate mean XR for each group at each time point
# =========================

df_summary <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(Group, all_of(xr_cols)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(xr_cols),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(df_summary)


# =========================
# 3) Convert to long format
# =========================

df_long <- df_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(xr_cols),
    names_to = "Time",
    values_to = "Repair_Level"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = gsub("^XR_", "", Time),
    
    Time = factor(
      Time,
      levels = time_order
    ),
    
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    )
  )

print(df_long)


# =========================
# 4) Colors
# =========================

custom_colors <- c(
  "C_H_M_H" = "#F28C9D",
  "C_H_M_L" = "#F3E065",
  "C_L_M_H" = "#65C9F3",
  "C_L_M_L" = "#9EAAE0"
)


# =========================
# 5) Plot
# =========================

p <- ggplot(
  df_long,
  aes(
    x = Time,
    y = Repair_Level,
    group = Group,
    color = Group
  )
) +

  # dashed line before 16 h
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 4.5,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.0
  ) +

  geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = custom_colors
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Repair Over Time",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Mean XR-seq RPKM",
    color = "Group"
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    )
  )


print(p)
```
